title: NHTSA 2006 Honda Ridgeline frontal crash test — Camera View-07
author: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA)

extraction.method: ffmpeg full decode with output-side -ss; re-encode as H.264, preserve playback frame rate, remove audio
extraction.timing_note: Requested extraction interval is 50.000–56.000 seconds of the source playback. The resulting 180-frame constant-rate file lasts 6.006 seconds at 30000/1001 fps. Use the extracted file as the frame-index reference.

contact_review.description: Estimated first visible bumper–barrier contact. Soft source detail and partial occlusion make the exact first physical contact ambiguous; deformation is clearly visible shortly afterward. The source camera time-zero mark is around clip frame 16 and is a separate reference.

measurement_limits: The published source is already slow motion. All processing/playback speeds are relative to this published source playback.
Playback frame rate is not physical camera capture frame rate. This demo does not infer real-world speed, acceleration, collision force, or fault.
The selected view is a controlled crash test, not an unplanned road collision; only a vehicle and test dummy are visible.
The media is a compiled edited source. Source time refers to the file playback clock, not elapsed physical test time.

verification.visual_checks: Fixed side view; short approach, front-barrier impact, crumple and rebound; no camera cuts in clip.
